unknown_on_confirmed_clear.note: UNKNOWN on a GT confirmed clear path

guidance_on_confirmed_clear.note: usable forward guidance on a GT confirmed clear path

false_stop_on_weak_clear.note: STOP on a weaker clear view (no GT danger + >=5 walkable points in body sweep)

guidance_coverage_all.note: frames with usable forward guidance / all frames

guidance_coverage_non_danger.note: usable guidance / frames without any GT danger

warning_within_horizon.note: first non-forward warning within 10 frames of onset

warning_at_onset.note: warning already on the onset frame

latency_p50_ms.note: desktop frame spacing, not phone latency

latency_p95_ms.note: desktop frame spacing, not phone latency

road_miss.note: GT road surface in body sweep -> forward guidance (conservative view)

road_miss_straight.note: GT road in body sweep -> STRAIGHT guidance (definite miss)

road_turn_guidance_not_evaluable.note: GT road in body sweep -> LEFT/RIGHT guidance; one frame cannot decide if the turn avoids it

road_danger_blocked_recall.note: GT road in body sweep NOT given forward guidance

curb_miss.note: GT curb in body sweep -> forward guidance (conservative view)

curb_miss_straight.note: GT curb in body sweep -> STRAIGHT guidance (definite miss)

curb_turn_guidance_not_evaluable.note: GT curb in body sweep -> LEFT/RIGHT guidance; single frame cannot decide

curb_danger_blocked_recall.note: GT curb in body sweep NOT given forward guidance

ground_miss.note: GT non-walkable ground in body sweep -> forward guidance (PR #15-class view)

ground_miss_straight.note: GT non-walkable ground in body sweep -> STRAIGHT guidance

ground_danger_blocked_recall.note: GT non-walkable ground in body sweep NOT forward-guided

occupancy_miss.note: GT 3D object occupancy in body sweep -> forward guidance (conservative view)

occupancy_miss_straight.note: GT 3D occupancy in body sweep -> STRAIGHT guidance (definite miss)

occupancy_turn_guidance_not_evaluable.note: GT 3D occupancy in body sweep -> LEFT/RIGHT guidance; single frame cannot decide

occupancy_blocked_recall.note: GT 3D occupancy in body sweep NOT forward-guided

any_miss.note: any GT danger in body sweep -> forward guidance (secondary, not one-sided)

any_danger_blocked_recall.note: any GT danger in body sweep NOT forward-guided
